lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਅਬ ਫੁਨਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau mai roop keee bahutere ab phun roop na hoee ||
lines.translation: In the past, I have taken many forms, but I shall not take form again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਗਾ ਤੰਤੁ ਸਾਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taagaa ta(n)t saaj sabh thaakaa raam naam bas hoee ||1||
lines.translation: The strings and wires of the musical instrument are worn out, and I am in the power of the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਚਨੋ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab mohi naachano na aavai ||
lines.translation: Now, I no longer dance to the tune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੀਆ ਨ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa man ma(n)dareeaa na bajaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind no longer beats the drum. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਫੂਟੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh maaiaa lai jaaree trisanaa gaagar phootee ||
lines.translation: I have burnt away sexual desire, anger and attachment to Maya, and the pitcher of my desires has burst.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਚੋਲਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ਗਇਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਛੂਟੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaam cholanaa bhaiaa hai puraanaa gaiaa bharam sabh chhootee ||2||
lines.translation: The gown of sensuous pleasures is worn out, and all my doubts have been dispelled. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਏਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਚੂਕੇ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਬਾਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab bhoot ekai kar jaaniaa chooke baad bibaadaa ||
lines.translation: I look upon all beings alike, and my conflict and strife are ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਏ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਸਾਦਾ ॥੩॥੬॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer mai pooraa paaiaa bhae raam parasaadaa ||3||6||28||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, when the Lord showed His Favor, I obtained Him, the Perfect One. ||3||6||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਮਨਾਵੈ ਅਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਦਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: rojaa dharai manaavai alahu suaadat jee sa(n)ghaarai ||
lines.translation: You keep your fasts to please Allah, while you murder other beings for pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਝਖ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aapaa dekh avar nahee dekhai kaahe kau jhakh maarai ||1||
lines.translation: You look after your own interests, and so not see the interests of others. What good is your word? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੋਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaajee saahib ek tohee mahi teraa soch bichaar na dekhai ||
lines.translation: O Qazi, the One Lord is within you, but you do not behold Him by thought or contemplation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਬਉਰੇ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khabar na karahi deen ke baure taa te janam alekhai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You do not care for others, you are a religious fanatic, and your life is of no account at all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਤੇਬ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਅਲਹੁ ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saach kateb bakhaanai alahu naar purakh nahee koee ||
lines.translation: Your holy scriptures say that Allah is True, and that he is neither male nor female.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਢੇ ਗੁਨੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: padhe gune naahee kachh baure jau dil mahi khabar na hoee ||2||
lines.translation: But you gain nothing by reading and studying, O mad-man, if you do not gain the understanding in your heart. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਹੁ ਗੈਬੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: alahu gaib sagal ghat bheetar hiradai lehu bichaaree ||
lines.translation: Allah is hidden in every heart; reflect upon this in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੭॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: hi(n)doo turak duhoo(n) mahi ekai kahai kabeer pukaaree ||3||7||29||
lines.translation: The One Lord is within both Hindu and Muslim; Kabeer proclaims this out loud. ||3||7||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥ ਤਿਪਦਾ ॥ ਇਕਤੁਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa || tipadaa || ikatukaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Ti-Pada, Ik-Tuka:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਓ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੇ ਤਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: keeo si(n)gaar milan ke taaee ||
lines.translation: I have decorated myself to meet my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har na mile jagajeevan gusaaee ||1||
lines.translation: But the Lord, the Life of the Word, the Sustainer of the Universe, has not come to meet me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har mero pir hau har kee bahureeaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is my Husband, and I am the Lord's bride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਬਡੇ ਮੈ ਤਨਕ ਲਹੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam bade mai tanak lahureeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord is so great, and I am infinitesimally small. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਏਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan pir ekai sa(n)g baseraa ||
lines.translation: The bride and the Groom dwell together.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਪੈ ਮਿਲਨੁ ਦੁਹੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sej ek pai milan duheraa ||2||
lines.translation: They lie upon the one bed, but their union is difficult. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਜੋ ਪੀਅ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n suhaagan jo pee bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Blessed is the soul-bride, who is pleasing to her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥੮॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer phir janam na aavai ||3||8||30||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, she shall not have to be reincarnated again. ||3||8||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeu ke dupade ||
lines.translation: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, Dho-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: heerai heeraa bedh pavan man sahaje rahiaa samaaee ||
lines.translation: When the Diamond of the Lord pierces the diamond of my mind, the fickle mind waving in the wind is easily absorbed into Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਇਨਿ ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sagal jot in heerai bedhee satigur bachanee mai paaee ||1||
lines.translation: This Diamond fills all with Divine Light; through the True Guru's Teachings, I have found Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee kathaa anaahad baanee ||
lines.translation: The sermon of the Lord is the unstruck, endless song.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੁਇ ਹੀਰਾ ਲੇਇ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)s hui heeraa lei pachhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Becoming a swan, one recognizes the Diamond of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹੀਰਾ ਅਸ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਜਗ ਮਹ ਰਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer heeraa as dekhio jag mah rahaa samaaee ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, I have seen such a Diamond, permeating and pervading the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤਾ ਹੀਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਓ ਜਬ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: gupataa heeraa pragat bhaio jab gur gam deeaa dikhaaee ||2||1||31||
lines.translation: The hidden diamond became visible, when the Guru revealed it to me. ||2||1||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੀ ਕਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲਖਨੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਬੁਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahilee karoop kujaat kulakhanee saahurai peeeai buree ||
lines.translation: My first wife, ignorance, was ugly, of low social status and bad character; she was evil in my home, and in her parents' home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕੀ ਸਰੂਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਲਖਨੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਉਦਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ab kee saroop sujaan sulakhanee sahaje udar dharee ||1||
lines.translation: My present bride, divine understanding, is beautiful, wise and well-behaved; I have taken her to my heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਮੁਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਬਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhalee saree muee meree pahilee baree ||
lines.translation: It has turned out so well, that my first wife has died.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਅਬ ਕੀ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug jeevau meree ab kee dharee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: May she, whom I have now married, live throughout the ages. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਬ ਲਹੁਰੀ ਆਈ ਬਡੀ ਕਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਟਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer jab lahuree aaee badee kaa suhaag tario ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, when the younger bride came, the elder one lost her husband.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਹੁਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਈ ਅਬ ਮੇਰੈ ਜੇਠੀ ਅਉਰੁ ਧਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: lahuree sa(n)g bhaee ab merai jethee aur dhario ||2||2||32||
lines.translation: The younger bride is with me now, and the elder one has taken another husband. ||2||2||32||
